title: 第3章 雨气第4章 迟客第5章 丹炉
content_zh:
青衫男子终于攀上巨岩。
足下岩石表面竟然异常光滑，俯身以手相触，只觉沁凉如玉，心中正自诧异，一股淡淡的腥气随风钻入鼻腔，不由蹙紧眉头，心里隐隐不安。
“快回来！”
先前离去的猎户去而复返，脸色惊慌拉满硬弓！
随行的黄狗夹紧尾巴凄惶哀鸣，转身撞进密林不见了踪影。
书童瞪大眼睛踉跄倒退，手里青皮葫芦没抓稳，咚的一声落地，清水汩汩涌出，在光滑岩石上漫开。
青衫男子僵硬艰涩回头。
巨岩的另一端，无声无息出现一条大黑蛇，乌黑色暗藏云状斑纹，高昂的蛇首微微低侧，人与蛇默然相对，四周空气仿佛凝固……
忽然间天色转暗，昏沉浓云遮蔽阳光。
黑蛇的分叉信子在空气中颤动，如探针无声读取风中流动气味。
发现对方没有威胁，且不适合猎食，无可乘之机，亦无争斗必要，既然如此便选择相安无事。
遵循与其它大型走兽之间的默契共存模式，至于小型动物则无需考虑。
青衫男子脑袋一片空白，直到黑蛇从身旁经过才清醒。
太大了！
近两丈长的黑蛇蠕行至老位置盘踞。
猎户几次将弓拉满，呼吸急促，粗糙的手指因用力微微颤抖，箭矢终究未能离弦，他不认为自家削制的箭簇能射杀大蛇。
如果没能一箭重创，蛇若暴起，结局难以预料。
好在大黑蛇并未发起攻击。
就在三人紧张屏息之际，忽然听到雨滴击打树叶啪嗒声，接着巨石表面陆续出现深色点痕。
上午的天色恍若黄昏，急雨吞没山野，激起的白雾逐渐模糊了天地界限。

白炽闪电蜿蜒落在山峰上，一个呼吸后，隆隆声滚滚而来。
轰鸣灌满了深谷。
三人早已浑身湿透却浑然不觉，瞠目望着眼前异象。
云纹黑蛇高高昂起头颅，朝向天空深长吞吐。
鳞片因湿润泛着诡秘幽光，黑蛇沉浸雨气的清凉，然而，在惬意喜悦之际，一缕熟悉的迷茫再度袭来，那道模模糊糊的束缚如影随形。
它不明白困扰来自何处，完全一无所知，难以穿透笼罩真相的迷雾。
思考，对黑蛇而言是极其艰难的事。
时常涣散，忘记，迷失方向，对捕猎以外的事无法专注，难以在它脑海中长久停留，似风中残烛飘摇难继。
三人已经悄然冒雨下山。
直至走出很远，忍不住回头，仍能隐约望见巨岩上高昂头颅的大蛇。
草丛窸窣，先前逃遁的黄狗浑身湿漉漉，摇着狗尾巴加入队伍。
满身泥泞烂叶回到潭边茅草屋，生起篝火，终于感到一丝暖意，三人一狗沉默围坐篝火周围，只有木柴噼啪响，脸色被火焰映照些许明暗不定的红光。
外面一道接一道闪电照亮山林，雷鸣层层叠叠。
猎户沉声说道。
“大人，山中凶险，不如早早出山，容我回去找些帮手，带上强弓利叉，将那大蛇或杀或逐，除了祸患再进山。”
说完看向青衫男子。
而男子正凝神思忖着什么，目光低垂，抬手接过书童奉上的热茶。
“不可。”
闻言，猎户和书童表示不解。
content_en:
The man in green shirt finally climbed up the huge rock.
The surface of the rock under my feet turned out to be extremely smooth. I leaned over and touched it with my hands. I felt it was as cool as jade. I was surprised in my heart. A faint fishy smell penetrated my nose with the wind. I couldn't help but frown, feeling uneasy.
"Come back quickly!"
The hunter who had left earlier came back again, his face full of panic and his bow full of strength!
The accompanying yellow dog clamped its tail and whined sadly, then turned around and ran into the dense forest and disappeared.
The book boy's eyes widened and he stumbled backwards. He lost his grip on the green-skinned gourd and fell to the ground with a thud. Clear water gurgled out and spread over the smooth rocks.
The man in green shirt turned around stiffly.
On the other end of the giant rock, a big black snake appeared silently. It was pitch black with hidden cloud-like markings. The head of the snake was raised slightly lowered. The man and the snake faced each other in silence, and the air around them seemed to be frozen...
Suddenly the sky turned dark, and thick clouds blocked the sunlight.
The forked letters of the black snake trembled in the air, like a probe silently reading the smell flowing in the wind.
If you find that the opponent is not a threat and is not suitable for hunting, there is no opportunity to take advantage of it, and there is no need to fight, in this case, you choose to live in peace.
Follow the tacit coexistence model with other large animals, and there is no need to consider small animals.
The man in green shirt's mind went blank, and he didn't wake up until the black snake passed by.
Too big!
The nearly two-foot-long black snake crawled to its old position and took up its position.
The hunter drew the bow fully several times, breathing rapidly, and his rough fingers trembled slightly due to the exertion, but the arrow could not leave the string after all. He did not think that the arrow clusters he made at home could kill the big snake.
If you fail to inflict serious damage with one arrow, the snake will burst into flames, and the outcome will be unpredictable.
Fortunately, the big black snake did not attack.
Just as the three of them were nervously holding their breath, they suddenly heard the sound of raindrops hitting the leaves, and then dark spots appeared on the surface of the boulder.
The sky in the morning seemed like dusk, the heavy rain engulfed the mountains and fields, and the white mist stirred up gradually blurred the boundary between heaven and earth.
Incandescent lightning fell on the mountain peaks, and after a breath, rumbles rolled in.
The roar filled the deep valley.
The three of them were already soaked to the skin but didn't realize it, staring at the strange sight in front of them.
The cloud-patterned black snake raised its head high and breathed deeply towards the sky.
The scales glowed with a mysterious light due to moisture, and the black snake was immersed in the coolness of the rain. However, at the moment of comfort and joy, a familiar feeling of confusion hit him again, and the vague restraint followed him like a shadow.
It does not understand where the trouble comes from, is completely clueless, and has difficulty penetrating the fog that surrounds the truth.
Thinking is extremely difficult for Black Snake.
It is often distracted, forgetful, and disoriented. It is unable to focus on things other than hunting. It is difficult to stay in its mind for a long time, like a candle fluttering in the wind.
The three of them had quietly gone down the mountain in the rain.
Until I walked far away, I couldn't help but look back, and I could still vaguely see the big snake with its head held high on the huge rock.
The grass rustled, and the yellow dog that had escaped earlier joined the team, wet all over, wagging its tail.
Covered in mud and rotten leaves, I returned to the thatched hut by the pond, lit a bonfire, and finally felt a bit of warmth. The three of them and one dog sat around the bonfire in silence. There was only the crackling of firewood, and their faces were illuminated by the flames with a slight red light.
Outside, one after another lightning illuminated the mountains and forests, and there were layers of thunder.
Orion said in a deep voice.
"Sir, the mountains are dangerous. It's better to leave the mountain early. Let me go back and find some helpers. I can bring a strong bow and a sharp fork to kill or drive away the big snake. I can eliminate the trouble before entering the mountain."
After speaking, he looked at the man in green shirt.
The man was concentrating on something, his eyes lowered, and he raised his hand to take the hot tea offered by the book boy.
"No."
Hearing this, Orion and Shutong expressed confusion.
